Ro.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the UI direction, but it sits over a murky, flat night-rain scene and has no teal selection, gold accents or controller button glyphs, so it falls short of Palworld's crisp HUD hierarchy.

Px.bar_b_note: A is a glossy terracotta clay-toy boar, off the owner's naturalistic bar; B's furred boar is closer, but its yellow leopard-like blotches lose the board's moss identity, and the faint-mid body hangs above its shadow.

So.bar_b_note: Side A's furred, lightning-veined wolf matches the owner style bar and Palworld creature finish with poses that read; side B's faint frames swap to a white coat with black blotches that would sink it on its own.

Ho.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder with a readable face and eyes and a meadow-green, earth-brown palette that sits in a stylised shipping game, though the soft animated-film face is a little rounder than the key art's trainer.

Ar.bar_b_note: A naturalistic furred wolf at style-bar finish with a clear rear-up flinch and a flat knocked-out faint; the near-black purple coat merging into the dark backdrop is what holds it back.

top_changes.change: Craft panel: keep side A's large type and full, untruncated recipe lines, but make the actions controller-first button prompts (glyph plus label) in teal/cyan with gold for the craftable state, and use a teal highlight for the selected recipe instead of a pale outline.

Rebuild Mudsnout as a naturalistic furred boar with moss patches at the owner style bar (Stormursa-level fur), standing clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, replacing both the clay-toy version and the yellow-blotched one.

Fix creature material and value issues: stop the faint-state material swap to a white-and-black coat (So B), add rim light and lift the values on the dark Tanglevolt-family coats so they separate from the backdrop, and place the trainer ruler clear of the creature's hind legs.
